note: 十段连续防御应急中英草稿。无真实秘密或攻击步骤，无猜测时间轴；音色和实际音频比例待验收。

series.title: 凭据泄漏：控制暴露、撤销与消费者恢复
series.premise: 构建扫描报告导出服务凭据出现在共享构建附件中，访问范围和使用记录尚未核实。
series.outcome: 限制附件访问并暂停导出，撤销泄漏凭据，使用独立受限替代凭据恢复消费者；确认一次非预期列表调用，未发现已记录的下载但日志存在空档。保留受控证据并继续影响调查。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 未来回访候选，不计实际出现；当前旧表达仅来自既有库、S03–S07及本文件此前。

dialogues.title: 先限制附件访问
dialogues.premise: 扫描发现构建附件疑似含有效凭据，尚未确认使用范围。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分限制传播与撤销凭据，听出立即认领的任务。

lines.en: The scanner flagged a shared build attachment. We need to contain the exposure before more downloads.
lines.zh: 扫描器标记了共享构建附件，需要在更多下载发生前控制暴露。

lines.en: Don't paste the value here. Is attachment access restricted yet?
lines.zh: 不要把值贴在这里。附件访问已经限制了吗？

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Restrict sharing now, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。现在就限制分享，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, but that won't invalidate credentials. Consumers need coordination too.
lines.zh: 对，但那不会让凭据失效，还需要协调消费者。

lines.en: I'm on it. The attachment's private now. Existing downloads remain unknown.
lines.zh: 我在做。附件现在已私有，之前下载情况仍未知。

lines.en: Just to confirm, pause exports, not billing? They're separate services.
lines.zh: 确认一下，暂停导出而非计费？它们是独立服务。

lines.en: That's sensible containment. Preserve access records without copying secrets around.
lines.zh: 这样控制合理。保存访问记录，不要到处复制秘密。

lines.en: What's the ETA for scope? About two minutes, maybe?
lines.zh: 范围确认预计多久？可能大约两分钟？

lines.en: First identify the credential owner from inventory. Don't restart unrelated workloads while scope is unknown.
lines.zh: 先从清单确认凭据所有者，范围未知时不要重启无关工作负载。

lines.en: A full deployment? Let's park that. I'll pause export fetching without discarding queued requests.
lines.zh: 完整发布？先放一边。我会暂停导出拉取，不丢弃排队请求。

dialogues.title: 权限比预期更宽
dialogues.premise: 附件访问已限制，导出暂停；通过秘密管理记录确认凭据归属。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出已知权限与尚未核实的实际访问。

lines.en: Credential scope includes the export bucket. It also permits object listing.
lines.zh: 凭据权限包含导出桶，也允许列出对象。

lines.en: Only today's exports, or older files? That changes potential impact.
lines.zh: 只有今天的导出，还是也有旧文件？这影响潜在范围。

lines.en: Older files too. That's our blast radius for potential access.
lines.zh: 也包括旧文件。这是潜在访问影响范围。

lines.en: Just to confirm, that's permission, not observed access, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，那是权限，不是已经观察到的访问，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. Permission isn't proof of use. We need request records.
lines.zh: 对。有权限不代表被使用，需要请求记录。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is debug output. I'll check build metadata.
lines.zh: 当前假设是调试输出泄漏。我会检查构建元数据。

lines.en: Could other consumers share this identity? Check scheduled jobs too.
lines.zh: 其他消费者会共用这个身份吗？也检查定时任务。

lines.en: Maybe the nightly report does. I can't rule that out yet.
lines.zh: 夜间报表可能共用，目前不能排除。

lines.en: Then don't call the inventory complete. Match owners against usage.
lines.zh: 那就别说清单完整，需要按使用情况核对所有者。

lines.en: I'm on it for contacts. Keep both export jobs paused.
lines.zh: 我来联系相关人。两个导出任务都保持暂停。

dialogues.title: 不等全量审计再撤销
dialogues.premise: 两个导出消费者已暂停，泄漏凭据可读取旧导出；审计仍在进行。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解短期业务延迟与持续泄漏风险的取舍。

lines.en: Let's revoke the credential now. Both known consumers are paused.
lines.zh: 现在撤销凭据，两个已知消费者都已暂停。

lines.en: Unknown consumers could fail. Is that risk explicitly accepted?
lines.zh: 未知消费者可能失败，这个风险已明确接受吗？

lines.en: Yes, export delays are acceptable. Billing doesn't use this identity.
lines.zh: 是的，导出延迟可接受。计费不使用这个身份。

lines.en: Check revocation propagation and sessions. A control-plane success isn't enough.
lines.zh: 检查撤销传播和会话，控制面成功还不够。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no overlap with the leaked credential, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，不让泄漏凭据与新凭据并存，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. Pausing exports can buy us time. Roughly ten minutes.
lines.zh: 对。暂停导出能争取时间，大约十分钟。

lines.en: Set an escalation path for unexpected failures. Don't silently ignore them.
lines.zh: 给意外故障设升级联系路径，不要默默忽略。

lines.en: What's the ETA for provider confirmation? I'll request it now.
lines.zh: 提供方确认预计多久？我现在申请确认。

lines.en: I'll observe a controlled rejection check. Record the effective time.
lines.zh: 我来观察受控拒绝检查，记录实际生效时间。

lines.en: Just to recap, recovery uses another identity. The exposed one stays revoked.
lines.zh: 小结一下，恢复用另一个身份，暴露的身份保持撤销。

dialogues.title: 替代凭据不继承过宽权限
dialogues.premise: 提供方确认旧凭据及关联会话失效，受控验证已拒绝。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别替代身份建立、秘密分发与消费者恢复的不同步骤。

lines.en: We can rotate credentials through the vault. The leaked one now rejects requests.
lines.zh: 可以通过秘密库轮换凭据，泄漏凭据现在拒绝请求。

lines.en: Does the replacement need listing? Don't copy unnecessary permissions.
lines.zh: 替代凭据需要列表权限吗？不要照搬不必要权限。

lines.en: Reads need exact object references. Listing belongs to another job.
lines.zh: 读取用准确对象引用，列表是另一个任务的职责。

lines.en: Okay, separate those roles. Just to confirm, vault delivery only, right?
lines.zh: 好，分开这两种角色。确认一下，只通过秘密库分发，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. Use managed configuration, not credentials in deployment notes.
lines.zh: 对。使用受管配置，不把凭据放进部署记录。

lines.en: I'm on it. New read access is limited to exports.
lines.zh: 我来做。新的读取权限限于导出文件。

lines.en: What's the rollback trigger? Recovery must never reactivate the exposed identity.
lines.zh: 回退触发条件是什么？恢复绝不能重新启用暴露身份。

lines.en: Failed reads mean pause again. Maybe a missing path needs review.
lines.zh: 读取失败就再次暂停，可能有遗漏路径需要评审。

lines.en: Start with a smoke test. Use an approved synthetic export.
lines.zh: 先做冒烟测试，用批准的合成导出数据。

lines.en: Agreed, one consumer first. Keep the nightly report paused meanwhile.
lines.zh: 同意，先一个消费者。夜间报表暂时继续暂停。

dialogues.title: 一条来源未匹配的记录
dialogues.premise: 替代读取凭据已部署到单个消费者，审计开始关联旧凭据请求与任务记录。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出不能从来源异常直接认定数据外泄。

lines.en: The access audit found a listing request. Its source isn't matched yet.
lines.zh: 访问审计发现一次列表请求，来源尚未匹配。

lines.en: Could that be our report worker? Its network address changed yesterday.
lines.zh: 可能是报表工作进程吗？它昨天更换过网络地址。

lines.en: Compare identity, request time, and job history. Address alone is weak evidence.
lines.zh: 对比身份、请求时间和任务历史，地址本身证据不足。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no confirmed download yet, right? Keep wording precise.
lines.zh: 确认一下，还没有确认下载，对吧？措辞要准确。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis was report traffic. That job wasn't running then.
lines.zh: 之前假设是报表流量，但那个时候任务没在运行。

lines.en: That weakens the explanation. We still have a logging gap.
lines.zh: 这削弱了该解释，而且日志仍有空档。

lines.en: I can't rule that out as unauthorized use. Provider logs may help.
lines.zh: 不能排除未经授权使用，提供方日志可能有帮助。

lines.en: Keep an eye on completeness too. Missing records aren't clean records.
lines.zh: 也关注完整性。记录缺失不代表没有异常。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for those logs? A rough range works.
lines.zh: 好，那些日志预计多久能拿到？大概范围就行。

lines.en: About thirty minutes, maybe longer. I'll preserve the job timeline now.
lines.zh: 大约三十分钟，也可能更久。我现在保存任务时间线。

dialogues.title: 非预期访问与下载未知
dialogues.premise: 列表请求与已知任务记录不符，提供方补充日志仍未到齐。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分潜在权限、已见列表调用与未知下载。

lines.en: We've got unaccounted access to object names. Downloads remain unconfirmed.
lines.zh: 对象名称存在无法解释的访问，下载仍未确认。

lines.en: The listing could expose customer labels. Names can carry sensitive data too.
lines.zh: 列表可能暴露客户标签，名称也可能包含敏感数据。

lines.en: Just to confirm, that's our blast radius for known activity, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，这是已知活动的影响范围，对吧？

lines.en: For recorded activity, yes. The logging gap prevents a complete conclusion.
lines.zh: 对已记录活动是这样，但日志空档阻止完整结论。

lines.en: I said no data exposure earlier. Correction, names may be exposed.
lines.zh: 我之前说没有数据暴露。更正一下，名称可能暴露。

lines.en: Let me play that back. Contents are unknown, not proven safe.
lines.zh: 我复述一下，内容是否暴露未知，不是已经证明安全。

lines.en: Exactly. Also, the root cause is still open for the leak.
lines.zh: 正是这样，而且泄漏根因仍未查明。

lines.en: Use our escalation path for privacy review. About an hour for assessment?
lines.zh: 走隐私评审升级路径，评估大约一小时？

lines.en: Ask the privacy lead to confirm timing. Don't invent notification obligations.
lines.zh: 请隐私负责人确认时间，不要自行编造通报义务。

lines.en: I'll send a sanitized summary. Evidence stays in the restricted case.
lines.zh: 我会发送脱敏摘要，证据留在受限案件记录中。

dialogues.title: 配置更新不等于任务通过
dialogues.premise: 恢复单个导出消费者后，准备验证实际读取和夜间报表独立身份。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出成功调用、失败日志与消费者清单的验证边界。

lines.en: Consumer validation passed for the first worker. It used the replacement identity.
lines.zh: 第一个工作进程的消费者验证通过，使用的是替代身份。

lines.en: Did you check completed exports? Successful authentication isn't the whole workflow.
lines.zh: 检查完成的导出了吗？认证成功不是完整工作流通过。

lines.en: Yes, the smoke test produced matching output. No duplicate delivery appeared.
lines.zh: 检查了，冒烟测试输出匹配，没有重复交付。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the report uses its own role, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，报表使用自己的角色，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, and the old identity still rejects. Keep those checks separate.
lines.zh: 是，而且旧身份仍拒绝请求。两类检查要分开。

lines.en: I'm on it for report validation. Maybe its schedule needs a controlled run.
lines.zh: 我来验证报表，可能需要一次受控运行来覆盖定时路径。

lines.en: Use approved test data first. Don't trigger duplicate customer notifications.
lines.zh: 先用批准的测试数据，别触发重复客户通知。

lines.en: Okay, I'll keep an eye on delivery counts. Both owners are present.
lines.zh: 好，我会关注交付计数，两个所有者都在。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation through the scheduled run. Hidden consumers may surface.
lines.zh: 继续观察到定时运行完成，隐藏消费者可能出现。

lines.en: Agreed, resume known jobs gradually. Audit investigation continues alongside recovery.
lines.zh: 同意，逐步恢复已知任务，恢复期间继续审计调查。

dialogues.title: 恢复和影响调查分开报告
dialogues.premise: 已知消费者恢复，旧凭据仍失效；隐私负责人评估通报要求。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出业务恢复不代表影响评估结束。

lines.en: Privacy owns the notification threshold. We won't wait for perfect logs.
lines.zh: 隐私负责人确定通报条件，不会为了完整日志一直等待。

lines.en: Good. Applicable deadlines still matter. Record who makes that decision.
lines.zh: 好。适用期限仍然重要，记录谁负责决定。

lines.en: Exports have recovered. The mitigation is holding for known consumers.
lines.zh: 导出已恢复，对已知消费者缓解持续有效。

lines.en: Say which consumers were checked. Don't imply complete incident closure.
lines.zh: 说明检查了哪些消费者，不要暗示事件完全结案。

lines.en: Just to confirm, summaries omit identifiers and secrets, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，摘要不含标识细节和秘密，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. What's the ETA for the next assessment? Roughly thirty minutes?
lines.zh: 对。下次评估预计多久？大约三十分钟？

lines.en: That's our checkpoint, not a guaranteed conclusion. Missing records may remain.
lines.zh: 那是检查点，不是保证能得出结论，可能仍缺记录。

lines.en: I'll circle back with support then. No clean-bill-of-health claim.
lines.zh: 那时我会回头联系支持团队，不宣称完全无风险。

lines.en: Include a contact for new failures. Service status can change.
lines.zh: 附上新故障联系人，服务状态可能变化。

lines.en: Just to recap, revoked access stays revoked. Logs and privacy review remain open.
lines.zh: 小结一下，撤销保持有效，日志和隐私评审仍未结束。

dialogues.title: 保留证据而非传播秘密
dialogues.premise: 补充日志到达但仍存在空档，需固化证据并清理可访问泄漏副本。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解证据留存、访问限制与源附件清理的顺序。

lines.en: Keep a restricted evidence copy. Don't preserve it in ordinary tickets.
lines.zh: 保留受限证据副本，不要放在普通工单中。

lines.en: I'm on it. Access is named and logged. The evidence custodian approved storage.
lines.zh: 我来做。访问实名且有记录，证据管理员已批准存储。

lines.en: What retention policy applies? Legal hold may override routine deletion.
lines.zh: 适用什么保留策略？法律保全可能优先于常规删除。

lines.en: Just to confirm, legal reviews that first, right? No blanket deletion.
lines.zh: 确认一下，先由法务评审，对吧？不全面删除。

lines.en: The source attachment can be removed afterward. Existing downloaded copies remain uncertain.
lines.zh: 之后可以移除源附件，既有下载副本仍不确定。

lines.en: Exactly. Removal limits distribution; revocation limits use. Neither erases history.
lines.zh: 对。移除限制传播，撤销限制使用，两者都不会抹掉历史。

lines.en: Managed configuration now disables debug credential output. Maybe older builds need review.
lines.zh: 受管配置已禁用调试凭据输出，旧构建可能还需检查。

lines.en: Check that separately. Today's logs don't establish every historical exposure.
lines.zh: 单独检查，今天的日志不能证明所有历史暴露情况。

lines.en: Okay, the root cause is still open for how debugging reached production.
lines.zh: 好，调试为何进入生产的流程根因仍未查明。

lines.en: I'll preserve the release approvals. Sanitized references go into the case timeline.
lines.zh: 我会保留发布审批，脱敏引用进入案件时间线。

dialogues.title: 门禁不能替代权限和审计
dialogues.premise: 确认调试输出进入附件，发布审批缺少秘密检测；影响调查因日志空档继续。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出预防任务的所有者、期限和验收边界。

lines.en: A secret scanning gate would block this attachment. It needs failure tests.
lines.zh: 秘密扫描门禁应阻止这种附件，还需要失败测试。

lines.en: Don't rely on scanning alone. Short-lived identities reduce exposure too.
lines.zh: 别只依赖扫描，短期身份也能减少暴露。

lines.en: Okay, who's picking this up? Each action item needs an owner.
lines.zh: 好，谁来接？每项待办都要有负责人。

lines.en: I'll own audit coverage by Friday. Logging gaps need explicit alarms.
lines.zh: 我负责周五前审计覆盖，日志空档需要明确告警。

lines.en: I'll own debug-output removal tomorrow. Then test export and report paths.
lines.zh: 我负责明天移除调试输出，然后测试导出和报表路径。

lines.en: I'll test the gate by Thursday. It must contain the exposure on failure.
lines.zh: 我周四前测试门禁，失败时必须控制暴露。

lines.en: Review identity lifetimes separately. Don't bundle untested changes into recovery.
lines.zh: 单独评审身份有效期，别在恢复中混入未经测试的变更。

lines.en: Just to recap, prevention isn't impact closure. Privacy review continues, right?
lines.zh: 小结一下，预防完成不等于影响结案，隐私评审继续，对吧？

lines.en: Yes. We'll close the loop with evidence, including unresolved coverage limits.
lines.zh: 对，我们会用证据完成反馈，也包括未解决的覆盖限制。

lines.en: Maybe another review next week. I'll keep the open questions visible.
lines.zh: 可能下周再评审一次，我会保留可见的未决问题。
